title: Proctor Silex Electric Coffee Grinder for Beans, Spices and More, Stainless Steel Blades, 12 Cups, White
description:
About this item
SIMPLE AND INTUITIVE: The electric coffee grinder is so simple to use that you'll want to drink flavorful coffee made from freshly ground coffee beans everyday. Just press the button to grind coffee and release to stop grinding.
NO ACCIDENTAL STARTS OR SPILLS: The built-in interlock prevents the coffee bean grinder from turning on when the safety on/off button is pressed unless the lid is locked securely in place.
POWERFUL PERFORMANCE AND PROVEN DURABILITY: The grinding blades on this small coffee grinder are made of durable stainless steel to grind coffee for brewing cup after delicious cup for years to come.
GRINDS ENOUGH COFFEE TO BREW UP TO 12 CUPS: If you love the delicious taste of coffee made from freshly ground coffee beans, this coffee grinder is perfect for you. Make a quick cup or a full pot.
GREAT FOR GRINDING HERBS & SPICES: Conveniently grind peppercorns, fennel and other herbs and spices for recipes or to keep on hand in the kitchen. Also great for grinding sesame, flax, chia and other seeds for smoothies, protein shakes or to add to food.

reviews_1s:
Pros:
It spins and will smash some things into finer bits.

Cons:
The blades are extremely dull, claim to be sharp and advise caution but are very, very dull!
Not sure about other reviews but I tried grinding herbs and spices to a powder and this machine was totally inefective.
I placed a small piece of celery in the chamber, just as a test for the blades, it smashed it about rapidly but did not actually cut it!
This is great if you want to smash things but useless if you actually want to grind them with cutting blades.

Conclusion:
As stated this was my second order as the first got lost during shipping, it finally showed up many days late but was opened inside the shipping bag and completely used and broken. I purchased this based upon the brand and the reviews but am sorry I did so as it is useless and must now be retuned for a refund. What happened to Proctor Silex quality?I do not think it is accurate to say this is big enough to grind beans for a whole pot of coffee. I’m confused how this has such a good rating. For 10 cups of coffee you need minimum 10 tablespoons of coffee beans. Well that amount barely fits in the grinder. If you wanted your coffee a little stronger or to make 12 cups it’s physically impossible to get that many coffee beans in the grinder. I wish people left more honest reviews. It’s way too smal!While it grinds well and is easy to use, it didn't work for my purpose. The interior is white plastic and can only be brushed clean! Right after the first round of grinding one spice, it took on its color and smell! No way to really clean it for a different spice. Might work well for those who want to use it solely for grinding one thing.The grinder starts as soon as it is plugged in even without the button being pressed. I picked up and the lid flew off throwing coffee everywhere and the grinding blades did not stop. Can only assume the locking mechanism is defective. Returned and bought a different brand.After grinding, even one time, the grounds stick to the bottom, needing to be scraped free. It scrapes free easily enough but it is a hassle. I like to grind beans for the week and the scraping in between each load is messy and time consuming. It grinds the beans great, isn’t very loud and the price was right but I really wish I would have returned it when I still could.I haven't used it yet, kind of scared to. I received it a few days ago but I just opened it and it's dirty. Smells like coffee, and has little specks of ground coffee.Was sent a used one! Disgusting.Stopped working after only 4 usesI clean the grinder immediately after use. But after one batch of chili, it caught the red spice color and is now impossible to clean. I bought this product for spice grinding and I am not happy that it leaves color marks.coffee grounds constantly stick to side. Its a pain and not very functional
